name: ctx-handoff
description: Hands off to a fresh conversation when context fills up, keeps the cache warm while you're away, and turns what you teach Claude into project notes

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Hand off to a new conversation once context reaches this many tokens. On smaller windows, window_ratio of the window is used instead.

window_ratio.title: Handoff threshold on smaller windows
window_ratio.description: Fraction of the context window that triggers a handoff when the window is smaller than the threshold.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes before keeping the cache warm
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without activity before each keep-warm request. The cache lasts 60 minutes. Skipped when the session only writes the 5-minute cache.

max_refresh.title: Keep-warm requests per idle period
max_refresh.description: After this many, a handoff summary is saved instead.

min_tokens.title: Smallest conversation worth handling (tokens)
min_tokens.description: Below this, no cache keeping, away handoff or notes update.

distill_every.title: Messages between notes updates
distill_every.description: Update the project notes in the background after this many of your messages. Fewer is fresher but makes more requests.

notes_model.title: Model for project notes
notes_model.description: Model that updates project notes in the background, at low effort.

inject_notes.title: Carry notes into new conversations
inject_notes.description: Put the contents of the project notes file into new conversations and your next message. Off by default: notes stay in the file and the panel, and the background update still runs.

card.title: Status card in _HANDOFF.md
card.description: After a handoff or when the background update has progress, update the status card between the ctx-handoff markers in the _HANDOFF.md of your project. With no such file the card is kept inside ctx-handoff only (/handoff card init creates it).

card_model.title: Model for the status card
card_model.description: Model that writes the status card, at low effort. Empty means the same model as the notes.

resume_hint.title: Tell new conversations where you stopped
resume_hint.description: A new conversation in the same folder within a day is told where the last one stopped (from the status card, or the progress note).

retry_nudge.title: Nudge on repeated failure
retry_nudge.description: When a tool fails twice in a row for the same reason, ask Claude to change approach.

done_check.title: Check before done
done_check.description: When Claude says done after editing code with no test or check, ask it to verify once.

command_guard.title: Confirm irreversible commands
command_guard.description: Ask before Bash or PowerShell runs rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE, npm publish and the like. With no screen to ask on (claude -p) the command runs as is and a line is logged.

reply_language.title: Reply language reminder
reply_language.description: Remind Claude once when its explanation is not in this language. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, off turns it off.

language.title: Message language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system language.
